issue.title: CI: Test against pandas 0.20.0rc1
issue.body:
Time for another game of let's see what broke!

Just one failure locally (though probably some warnings, I'll followup with a PR).

Pandas issue for the thing causing the failure https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/issues/16107 (`pd.unique` with strings and NaN casts the NaN to a string).

rename.from: REGR: pd.unique casts nan to string
rename.to: REGR: pd.unique casts nan to string with other strings

body: hmm, unique is taking a more general path now, I think this is inferred to string (and not object)
